profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Intuit
profile.summary:
• 14+ years of Software Product Development experience with proven expertise in technical design & architecture, product development, programming and release management.
• 7+ years of experience in developing product roadmaps collaborating effectively with customer-side management, product managers and business analyst.

TECHNICAL SKILLS: 
♣ Agile development using Scrum ( JIRA, Trello)
♣ Global Teams (onsite, offshore and remote)
♣ Team building and mentoring 
♣ Cross-functional collaboration
♣ Architecture and design patterns
♣ Programming languages (Java, JavaScript, React, Redux, C++) 
♣ Backend technologies (Java, Spring, Microservices, REST services, SOAP services)
♣ Microservices frameworks (Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Netflix OSS components(Eureka, Zuul, Hystrix), Rabbit MQ, Kafka, Zookeeper, Swagger, JSON)
♣ Cloud (AWS - Lambda, ECS, API Gateway, SQS, SNS) Serverless API, Azure
♣ Databases (Oracle, MySQL, NoSQL-Couchbase, MongoDB)

positions.title: Senior Software Specialist
positions.description:
Leading development using Microservices architecture with Spring Boot, Spring Cloud config, Netflix OSS components(Eureka, Zuul, Hystrix), Rabbit MQ, Kafka, Zookeeper, Couchbase, Oracle, Restful Web Services.
Working closely with customer/user and product managers to analyze & prioritize requirements and establish a product road-map.
Providing technical leadership during PDLC stages such as product concept & road-map, architecture, functional and technical design, development and go-live.
Complete understanding and hands on experience in Agile development methodologies.

positions.title: Software Development Lead
positions.description:
Development Lead for Amdocs OSS/CRM, live at AT&T, Altice, Comcast
Lead product development effort working closely with the development manager, product manager and customer
Developed deep expertise in delivering scalable enterprise-grade web apps using RESTful Web Service (JAX-RS), Spring frameworks, MySQL, MongoDB
Lead customer engagement all stage of software delivery life-cycle, single point of contact setting the agenda and facilitating the meeting
Mentor team members including setting learning goals, career planning, reviewing performance and establishing a positive working environment

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Full stack software developer with expertise in software development using JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, Angular.js, Backbone.js, responsive design, JQuery, Java, JSP-Servlets, Spring, JDBC, XML, JUnit, PL/SQL, Oracle, MySQL, MongoDB
Expertise in App/Web servers such as Weblogic App server, WildFly(JBoss) and Apache.
Experience in design & development tools such as Eclipse, MS Visio, Notepad++, SQL developer/TOAD, XMLSpy

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on multiple software development projects using Java/J2EE & Oracle technology
Responsibilities included detailed design, development, unit and system testing
Technology: Java, J2EE, Oracle, HTML, JavaScript, UML, Unix/Linux

positions.title: Research Associate
positions.description:
Worked as Research Trainee on Grid and Cloud Computing
Worked on project for making Meta-computing Environments Grid compliant
